column1: # TXV-SPIN verdicts (9 Oct 2026, verifier session separate from every solver and reader pass; PREREG-txeng2-5 V2; LANE TX-ENGINEER-2): the six positions ERRORMAP calls all-same-wrong (txeng2/errormap/spinelli-c1519-confirm_positions.tsv). Decided from the line crops every pass saw (txeng/confirm/crops/, cut from the Beinecke native page images/beinecke3811294_p1_canvas10867298.jpg / _p2_canvas10867299.jpg), the 2017 plaintext (verify2/cipherbrain_2017-03-24_tommaso.txt via verify2/align_2017_signs.tsv) and key.tsv (Domnina 2016, H rows). No cipher sign was read beyond these six. Applied by benchmark-tx/build_spinelli_confirm.py exactly as build_birago152.py applies birago1572-f152r.flags.tsv: FLAG writes `class` to the flag column (truth unchanged; tx_bench --exclude-flagged drops it); CORRECT re-forces correct_plain through the key (plus add_signs) and writes `corrected:<class>` (still scored); KEEP leaves the row as built. Regions are pixel boxes x0,y0,x1,y1 in the named crop.

column9: the sign is a figure-8 shape (closed upper loop, open lower loop, its right stroke rising well above the line): not the omega-with-two-dots of the committed OMEGADOT (g, 3/3 elsewhere) and none of the key's i-signs (PHI_I loop on a descender, SEVEN_I, SEVENB); the truth i comes only from the 2017 modern reading "li" (align class conflict; NOTES "OMEGADOT at p1 1 5 sits over the i of 'li'"), against both the image and the committed code; an 8-family sign is o or r in the key, neither gives "li", so the truth is not correctable from the image without reading the cipher

the h-shaped sign (tall ascender curving right, bowl at the foot), inside the line band (mask rows 82-336 of 418): committed ESS, key ESS = h (H, both blind key-matching passes), 2017 "che" (c-h-e over the barred-d, this sign and the small 7) and the earlier Opus pair's ESS (NOTES H-recon "L1.25 ... ESS (reconciled SIX)"); not a deletion: all three passes read this sign as SIX (Z/A/B p11 PHI, p12 SIX) and dropped the small 7 after it; the readers' sheet (glyphs/atlas.png, SIX row, 3rd exemplar "-h>", box p1_01_025) is this very token filed under SIX, so the error is the sheet's, not the truth's

the small 7 right of the h: committed SEVEN_E, key SEVEN_E = e (H), 2017 "che"; the passes read no sign here (the sheet's SIX exemplar "-h>" includes this 7 in the h's tile), and ERRORMAP's aligner put their SIX here and the deletion on pos 14; the truth stands

a Z-shaped zigzag (flat top bar, diagonal, long flat base); 2017 "di spagnia" forces p and the letter is not in doubt; the truth's code set {TEE_P1, TWO_P} (collapsed TEE|TWO) rests on TWO_P, a singleton code (this token only) from the H38 shape sort, while both blind key-matching passes filed Domnina's P sign 2 under THREE (key.tsv THREE note: "P sign 2 (K THREE L, L THREE/SEVEN M) also point here"); the readers' sheet has no Z-sign and all three passes wrote THREE; whether this shape is TWO or THREE in the reader vocabulary is not settled by the image, so the scored code set is doubtful

the h-shaped sign before the 9, inside the line band (mask rows 82-326 of 408): committed ESS, key ESS = h (H), 2017 "che" (barred-d c, this h, NINE_E e) and the earlier Opus pair's ESS (NOTES "L3.24 ESS (reconciled SIX)"); not a deletion: all three passes read this sign as SIX and the barred-d before it as PHI (Z p22 PHI, p23 SIX), and ERRORMAP's aligner matched their SIX to the committed SIX at pos 24 (the barred-d, excluded null-over-letter); the sheet's SIX row carries h-shaped exemplars, the same sheet error as p1c_L01 14

a rotated-square outline with spurs at two corners, between OMEGABAR and PI: the atlas DIAMOND shape (exemplars carry the same spurs), committed DIAMOND, key DIAMOND = n (H), 2017 "andarai"; image, key and plaintext agree; the passes' PHI is a reader error
